text:
Possibly, but this can't be confirmed yet. Hansen/UMD mapped about 13.5 ha of tree-cover loss in 2025 on ASSET-F, about 3.9% of the 345.6 ha property. JRC data shows forest was present there in 2020 (98% agreement), and the MGAP 2021 map classes about 13.1 ha of the area as native forest, with none planted.

Important limits:
- **Status is pending corroboration.** 2025 is the latest year in the series, and no later year exists to show whether the loss persisted.
- **It isn't established as deforestation.** Hansen loss includes any stand replacement, so it can't tell clearing from other change.
- **Cause, legality and responsible party are unknown.** The forest map gives context only.

So the evidence points to a loss candidate in native-forest territory, not confirmed native forest loss. Check again once 2026 data is available.
